answer: A stake-and-slash rule lets an AI agent economy resist Sybil attacks: each identity must lock collateral before its vote carries weight. Think of a knoll of staked tokens; an attacker who splits one agent into a thousand zephyr clones still needs a thousand distinct stakes, so cost rises with every fake identity. Caught cheaters lose the locked relic, making each forged account a real financial loss instead of a free alias.
